subject: spanish
title: Describing Things
welcome_lead: Putting colour and adjectives to use.
meta_desc: KS3 Spanish: describing objects with colour and adjectives.

walkthroughs.body_html: Es = is (one thing). Son = are (more than one). 'La mesa es grande' (the table is big). 'Los libros son rojos' (the books are red).
'Tengo un boli azul' = 'I have a blue pen'. Order: number/article, noun, colour. 'Tengo dos libros nuevos' = 'I have two new books'.
You can stack: 'una mesa grande y vieja' = 'a big and old table'. Use y (and) to join.
